title: Syrian Flatbread Stuffed with Oozing Pudding
description: A rich, satisfying dessert featuring crispy flatbread filled with creamy pudding and topped with sweet black pudding.
instructions: Cut flatbread into squares, about 3 inches (7.5 cm) per side.
Place flatbread squares on a baking sheet.
Dollop a spoonful of oozing pudding onto the center of each flatbread square.
Top with a spoonful of crumbled Syrian pudding and black pudding.
Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until flatbread is crispy and pudding is golden.
Serve warm, with additional oozing pudding for drizzling (if desired).
